label: PETE / PET
common_uses: Soft drink bottles, mineral water bottles, food jars, strapping, polyester textile fibers
notes: Widely recycled; commonly used for clear beverage containers and packaging

label: HDPE
common_uses: Milk containers, detergent bottles, shampoo bottles, chemical drums, pipes, toys
notes: Excellent chemical resistance and moisture barrier properties

label: PVC
common_uses: Plumbing pipes, electrical conduit, cable insulation, window frames, medical tubing
notes: Available in rigid and flexible forms; contains chlorine

label: LDPE
common_uses: Plastic bags, squeeze bottles, shrink wrap, flexible container lids, agricultural films
notes: Flexible, tough, and transparent or translucent

label: PP
common_uses: Food containers, yogurt cups, bottle caps, automotive battery cases, microwaveable ware
notes: High thermal resistance and fatigue resistance; suitable for hot liquids

label: PS
common_uses: Disposable cutlery, foam drink cups, packaging peanuts, CD jewel cases, meat trays
notes: Rigid and brittle in solid form; expanded form (EPS) used for thermal insulation

label: OTHER / PC
common_uses: Reusable water bottles, food containers, electronics housings, safety goggles, automotive lenses
notes: Catch-all category for plastics other than resin codes 1-6, including Polycarbonate, ABS, Acrylic, and multi-layer materials

label: 24K
common_uses: Gold bullion bars, minted coins, investment ingots
notes: Highest commercial gold purity; too soft for standard daily-wear jewellery

label: 22K
common_uses: Traditional Indian gold jewellery, bangles, chains, necklaces, bridal ornaments
notes: Primary purity grade for hallmarked gold jewellery in India

label: 21K
common_uses: Specialty jewellery, regional traditional ornaments, rings
notes: Recognized under hallmarking standards for fine gold jewellery

label: 18K
common_uses: Diamond-studded jewellery, modern rings, luxury watches, delicate gemstone settings
notes: Higher mechanical hardness compared to 22K; ideal for gem-setting

label: 14K
common_uses: Contemporary everyday jewellery, lightweight fashion ornaments, earrings

label: 9K
notes: Minimum karatage recognized under standard gold hallmarking grades

label: Sterling Silver
common_uses: Silver jewellery, utensils, tableware, pooja articles, gift ware
notes: Standard international and Indian purity grade for sterling silver (alloyed with 7.5% copper)

label: Coin Silver
common_uses: Silver coins, decorative medallions, traditional silver artefacts
notes: Recognized silver purity grade for minted artefacts and coins

label: Grade 304 / AISI 304
common_uses: Kitchen sinks, cookware, food processing equipment, architectural trim
notes: Nominal 18% chromium and 8% nickel; corrosion-resistant austenitic grade

label: Grade 316 / AISI 316
common_uses: Chemical containers, marine hardware, medical implants, high-salinity food processing
notes: Contains 2-3% molybdenum for superior resistance to pitting and chloride corrosion

label: Fe 500 / Fe 500D
material_name: High Yield Strength Deformed TMT Steel Bars
common_uses: Reinforced concrete construction, bridges, residential and commercial buildings
notes: Thermo-mechanically treated steel rebar with minimum yield strength of 500 MPa
